name: db-tunnel
description: Query DEV/SEMI/PROD databases via SSH tunnels or direct connections. Supports PostgreSQL and MySQL. Credentials stored in OS Keychain.

tools.name: list_environments
tools.description: List all configured database environments and their current connection status.

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Open SSH tunnel (if needed) and database connection for an environment.

totp_code.description: 6-digit TOTP code (only for PROD if secret not stored in keychain)

tools.name: disconnect
tools.description: Close database connection and SSH tunnel for an environment.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Execute SQL on a connected environment. SELECTs auto-capped at row limit. Destructive statements need allow_mutations: true.

tools.name: list_schemas
tools.description: List all schemas (PostgreSQL) or databases (MySQL) in a connected environment.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Get column definitions, types, nullability, defaults, and PK flags for a table.

tools.name: set_credential
tools.description: Save a credential (ssh-password, db-password, totp-secret) to OS Keychain for an environment.

tools.name: delete_credential
tools.description: Remove a credential from OS Keychain (use when password changes).
